locations.topic: Real Fourier expansion and mean convention
Vanishing rate harmonics above order1 and cosine potential

normalization.source_notation_issue: PDF Eq24 writes p0/2 as constant term, whereas Eq25 relaxes p0 to1/(2ell). The mean here is defined by direct integral of the original PDE and does not inherit that mismatch.

theorem_scope.spaces: Real periodic H^s for s>=0; classical C^1 data also covered by the explicit formula
theorem_scope.nonlinear_orbital_stability: Direct orthogonal distance identity, not a smooth semigroup or normal hyperbolicity theorem
theorem_scope.regularity_caveat: Translations are strongly continuous but not operator-norm continuous on H^s; no same-space Frechet-C1 solution-map claim is made
theorem_scope.physical_domain: 0<=q_j<=1 preserved if 0<=f<=1; every finite periodic orbit lifts physically if sqrt(A^2+B^2)<=1/2

algebra_check.limitations: Algebra controls do not substitute for the explicit infinite-dimensional proof or the inherited finite orbit certificates

cache_policy: Downloaded primary PDF and rendered pages remain in ignored outputs; no source PDF or page image included in tracked artifacts
